visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a vibrant television studio with high-intensity purple and blue neon backlighting. Five individuals—a male host, a mentor, and three contestants—stand in a line on a black stage floor. The host holds a microphone, gesturing towards the group. The contestants display varied facial expressions ranging from nervous smiles to focused attention. (2) A montage of performance scenes begins. First, two young women in high school uniforms (white shirts, black skirts) are on stage; one sits on a chair with a slumped posture while the other stands behind her with crossed arms and a stern expression. Next, two women in casual modern clothing engage in a physical confrontation, with one pulling the other's arm against a backdrop of glowing geometric patterns. (3) The first featured performance segment shows a woman in a white turtleneck and grey cardigan facing a man in a brown jacket. Her face is contorted in emotional distress, mouth open as if shouting. She physically lunges at the man, who holds her arms to stabilize her. The scene ends with her collapsing onto her hands and knees on the stage floor. (4) The second performance segment features the two students again. The girl sitting on the chair looks downcast, her eyes red, while the standing girl leans in close to speak, her face showing a mix of concern and accusation. The lighting is cooler and more focused on the central interaction. (5) The third performance segment features a woman in a white oversized hoodie confronting another woman wearing a tight white top and a glittering silver sequined skirt. They stand close together, the woman in the hoodie pointing a finger aggressively while the other maintains a stiff, defensive posture. (6) A mentor, a woman with blonde-streaked hair in a white vest, sits at a long judging table. She speaks animatedly into a microphone, her eyes wide and hands gesturing to emphasize her excitement. Other judges are visible in the background, partially obscured. (7) The final scene returns to the group on the main stage. The contestants are cheering and raising their hands in celebration. The host stands at the far left, smiling broadly. The video ends with a brief shot of the two schoolgirl characters back in their scene, one looking away with a defiant expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 《戲戲品味》來到第九集半決賽. [Logo]: @ethan_kuan_kuan. (2) [Subtitle]: 這次的賽制是導師戰隊賽. (3) [Subtitle]: 由三位評審分別選出兩位隊員. (4) [Subtitle]: 要親自來指導他們的表演. (5) [Subtitle]: 不過最狠的就是啊. (6) [Subtitle]: 兩人只有其中一個人可以晉級. (7) [Subtitle]: 太殘忍了吧. (8) [Variety]: 【楊潔玫 戰隊表演】. [Subtitle]: 全部都怪我好了. (9) [Subtitle]: 怪我不夠了解你對不對. (10) [Subtitle]: 我就只是想要一個家. (11) [Subtitle]: 張彥鈞 回來. (12) [Variety]: 【范健祐 戰隊表演】. [Subtitle]: 鍾心妤. (13) [Subtitle]: 你幹嘛不告訴老師. (14) [Subtitle]: 就像當初你那樣啊. (15) [Variety]: 【何嘉文 戰隊表演】. [Subtitle]: 你要演多久. (16) [Subtitle]: 我沒媽不就是因為你. (17) [Subtitle]: 你害死我媽欸. (18) [Subtitle]: 從五歲那年 你進來我們家. (19) [Subtitle]: 害得我們全家 分崩離析. (20) [Subtitle]: 不就是因為你嗎. (21) [Subtitle]: 身為指導老師 其實也有很多感受想說. (22) [Subtitle]: 哇 剛剛這台上 簡直是大爆發. (23) [Subtitle]: 嚇到媽媽了我. (24) [Subtitle]: 讓我們恭喜同學們進入決賽. (25) [Subtitle]: 到底誰可以抱走第一名獎金呢. (26) [Subtitle]: 我們下集見.
